source_refs.note: 1. Allopatric Speciation: a main subheading of 1.8 Species and speciation, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 32-33.

blocks.text: Yeh tab hoti hai jab ek aabadi geographically (zameeni rukawat, jaise pahar, darya ya samandar se) do ya zyada alag groups mein bat jati hai. Yeh groups mukhtalif mahol ka saamna karte hain aur alag alag evolve hote hain. Waqt ke saath jama hone wale farq itne bare ho jate hain ke interbreeding ruk jati hai, chahe baad mein zameeni rukawat hat bhi jaye. Misal: Galápagos Islands par Darwin ki finches (chiriyon) mein speciation, jahan mukhtalif aabadiyan mukhtalif mahol ke mutabiq dhal gayin.
